## Core Entities

### Client
Represents an individual seeking services.

Attributes:
- ClientId
- FirstName
- LastName
- DateOfBirth
- VeteranStatus
- DisabilityStatus
- ChronicHomelessStatus

### Household
Represents one or more clients receiving services together.

### Assessment
Represents a coordinated entry assessment.

### ProgramEnrollment
Represents participation in a housing program.

### HousingPlacement
Represents successful housing placement.

### CaseNote
Represents interactions between staff and clients.

### ServiceTransaction
Represents services delivered to clients.
